project: 双鱼部落写作业机器人

architecture.legacy: CDP/RongCloud modules retained as historical references; not part of Android execution

capabilities.privateText: exact UID user search, full profile and chat-peer UID verification, first or existing conversation with guarded text input
capabilities.collect: bounded multi-room traversal, member pagination and matched public user-card UID resolution; not a complete online roster
capabilities.welcome: available welcome control only; skip if absent
capabilities.call: available expression control only; no silent text fallback
capabilities.taskConcurrency: one device operation at a time
capabilities.demo: explicit choice; no real sends or real-send statistics

deliveryGuarantee: UI confirmation is not server delivery confirmation
